text:
rachael: Quick ask from marketing — we need a compact, reproducible bench pack to cite in the launch post and to show one slide in the webinar. Can runtime run a focused smoke/sanity job?
omar: Sure. What do you need in the pack?
rachael: Minimal but verifiable: manifest with exact model checksum and run command, per-request CSV (latency, tokens, qps), 10 token-level traces sampled, README with variance caveat, and a 1-slide PNG (p50/p95/p99). Also note cache config and warmup policy.
vik: Which model/quant/hw and qps/warmup?
rachael: Model: marketing-demo-v3 (I'll DM checksum). Hardware: h100-small pool. Variants: int8 and fp16. Short demo: 256 tokens @50 qps. Long demo: 2048 tokens streaming @8 qps. Warmup: 3 windows then steady-state. Seed: mkting-seed-2026.
lina: Do you want both coldstart and warmed runs?
rachael: Yes — include a coldstart trace and a warmed steady-state run for the short demo. For the long demo include streaming and non-streaming steady-state.
sam: Token traces are heavy. You asked for 10 sampled traces?
rachael: Yep — mixed lengths (short/med/long) so PRs can inspect emission patterns. Per-request aggregates for everything else.
omar: We'll produce artifact: manifest.txt, per_request.csv, token_traces_10.csv, README.md, pstat_slide.png. README will include an explicit reproducible command and the single-run variance note.
vik: Please also capture cache-hit rates and GPU utilization summary in the manifest so marketing can explain differences between cold and warm.
lina: Timeline? When do you need the smoke pack?
rachael: Need smoke pack by Tue 9am PT to lock slide and post copy. Full sweep (all quant variants + kernel flags) can come later.
omar: Smoke run ETA Tue 07:30 PT. We'll queue a short job and post the GCS link here. If anyone needs a quick rerun at different qps we can do a fast-follow on one variant.
sam: We'll label experimental int4 if it's stable but don't include it in the official blurb unless it's production-safe.
rachael: Agreed. Also add this line in README for copy: "Single-run smoke artifacts; expect +/-10% variability on p95 due to scheduler and caching effects."
omar: Got it. Example run command we'll include in README:
```
MODEL=marketing-demo-v3 CHECKSUM=sha256:abcd1234 RUN_SEED=mkting-seed-2026 ./bench/run_smoke.sh --qps 50 --tokens 256 --warmup 3
```
runtime-bot: job 224455 queued on h100-small. ETA ~45m for smoke.
omar: Upload path will be gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5167890123/smoke_pack.tar.gz
runtime-bot: job 224455 finished successfully. upload: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/5167890123/smoke_pack.tar.gz (2.9MB)
rachael: Downloading now. I'll verify p50/p95/p99 and ping here if copy needs edits.
lina: I'll sanity-check the manifest and confirm the kernel/quant flags map to our ops docs. If variance >10% we'll request a rerun here.
omar: Standing by for followups. If you want a rerun toggling prefix-cache on/off that's a quick ~30m job.
sam: Added a short note in the manifest about whether prefix cache sharing was enabled and TTL values.
rachael: Perfect — this should let us lock the slide and ship the post. Thanks team :heart:
